messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social behaviour and attitudes, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, and Equality, inequality and social exclusion in Germany during the 1990s, matching this research need: survey data on political attitudes and participation in Germany, including voting behavior, party preferences, trust in institutions, democratic values, political efficacy, media use, social welfare views, and differences between East and West
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS ALLBUS 1990 1992 1994 1996 1998 Germany political attitudes east west dataset
German Longitudinal Election Study 1990 1994 1998 election study GESIS dataset
World Values Survey Germany 1990 1997 data political trust democracy
German social survey 1990s ISSP role government social inequality Germany dataset
